discription: A continuously evolving, slightly noisy drone sound generated by mixing a low-frequency sine wave with filtered white noise, passed through a long release envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=60, amp=0.1, gate=1, noiseMix=0.2, lpfCutoff=2000; var sig, env, noiseSig; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.5, 0.5, 0.7, 5.0, curve: -2), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = SinOsc.ar(freq); noiseSig = WhiteNoise.ar * LPF.ar(WhiteNoise.ar, lpfCutoff); sig = (sig * (1 - noiseMix)) + (noiseSig * noiseMix); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
